The restaurant is spacious, even large families can be comfortable.
Oct 2026 • Family
We're stopping by for dinner after walking around the sea cultural events at the end of September. Real review of dinner at Johnny Steak House
Sep 2026 • Couples
What I like about the restaurant is the spacious layout, the tables and chairs are not crowded, and especially the clothes don't get too much smoke smell. The two of them ordered two steaks with two different sauces to change the flavor. Spicy sauce has a medium spiciness, while mushroom sauce leans towards a light richness, and both go well with meat. The drinks are also fine, not the kind that have too much sugar so you get sick of them after a few sips. The staff are mainly young people but speak politely, and ordering or paying is quite fast. Nha Trang is in the low season this time, but the overall experience is still stable.

Grab a quick dinner before returning to Hanoi
Aug 2026 • Business
Before going to the airport to Hanoi, I took the opportunity to grab a meal to make sure I was full. Looking at the initial price list, it seems quite reasonable for a steak restaurant; after ordering, the bill is also detailed, with clear VAT, so there's no need to ask further questions. I choose steak with grilled shrimp and cheese. The meat is fragrant, the shrimp is still fresh, and the grilled cheese on top is quite palatable. The staff asked me what level of doneness I wanted the meat, and advised quite quickly, without wasting much time. Since it's close to the holiday, the restaurant is busier than usual, but the service is still relatively efficient. It's just the air conditioning in the cold room, sitting for a long time feels a bit chilly.

Go alone to a restaurant for a delicious steak.
Aug 2026 • Solo
That day I went alone, spent the whole afternoon driving around Nha Trang, and when I was hungry in the evening, I stopped to look for something to fill my stomach. Saw a steak restaurant, so I went in to try it. I ordered a portion of grilled meat and beef brains with bread. The steak is cooked perfectly, and the seasoning isn't too strong, so you can still taste the meat. The fatty, soft beef brain dish with crispy bread is quite interesting; this is the first time I've tried this style. The restaurant had customers but wasn't noisy; I chose a slightly secluded table so I could sit alone comfortably. The menu and prices are clear, and ordering is easy. When I have a chance to return to Nha Trang, I will stop by again.
